# speckit model api select

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Select first remote model id and persist it machine-local for first role (`semantic.openai.embedModel` / `rerankModel` / `judgeModel`)

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit model api select [OPTIONS] --role <ROLE> <ID>
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit model api select --help
```
